title: NullPointerException in JavaModelManager.getJavaElement during incremental build of large Maven multi-module project
description: Eclipse JDT builder crashes when scanning deleted package-info.java in sub-project during background incremental workspace compilation.
comments: Added null check in JavaModelManager for deleted IResource references before attempting cache resolution.

title: SWTException: Invalid thread access when updating ProgressMonitorDialog from background fork
description: Updating UI labels or progress bars from an asynchronous non-UI worker thread triggers SWTException: Invalid thread access.
stack_trace:
org.eclipse.swt.SWTException: Invalid thread access
	at org.eclipse.swt.SWT.error(SWT.java:4533)
	at org.eclipse.swt.SWT.error(SWT.java:4448)
	at org.eclipse.swt.SWT.error(SWT.java:4419)
	at org.eclipse.swt.widgets.Widget.error(Widget.java:482)
	at org.eclipse.swt.widgets.Widget.checkWidget(Widget.java:380)
	at org.eclipse.swt.widgets.ProgressBar.setSelection(ProgressBar.java:278)
comments: Fixed by wrapping widget mutation calls inside Display.getDefault().asyncExec(() -> { ... }).

title: BundleException: Could not resolve module due to circular package exports in OSGi manifest
description: Equinox OSGi runtime fails to activate bundle when two companion plugins declare circular Split-Package directives with require-bundle dependencies.
stack_trace:
org.osgi.framework.BundleException: Could not resolve module: org.eclipse.core.runtime [12]
  Unresolved requirement: Require-Bundle: org.eclipse.equinox.common; bundle-version="[3.10.0,4.0.0)"
	at org.eclipse.osgi.container.Module.start(Module.java:444)
error_message: org.osgi.framework.BundleException: Unresolved requirement in bundle manifest
comments: Refactored shared interfaces into separate utility bundle and switched from Require-Bundle to Import-Package directives.

title: OutOfMemoryError: Metaspace exhausted during repeated plugin reload in developer sandbox
description: Classloaders created for dynamic OSGi bundle reloading are not garbage-collected because static event listeners hold hard references to bundle activator classes.
stack_trace:
java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Metaspace
	at java.lang.ClassLoader.defineClass1(Native Method)
	at java.lang.ClassLoader.defineClass(ClassLoader.java:763)
	at org.eclipse.osgi.internal.loader.ModuleClassLoader.defineClass(ModuleClassLoader.java:298)
comments: Cleaned up static event listener registrations in BundleActivator.stop() lifecycle hook.
